decisions.reason: Simplifying the model interface does not change the confirmed capital-stack, financing-rate, tranche, mezzanine, or refinement assumptions; the word simplified in the debt structure is incidental.
The interface-organization decision does not change capex values, assumption sources, included costs, or the requirement to present shared program costs as separate line items.
Simplifying presentation does not alter the eight-site configuration, site-list source, or policy for modeling unavailable site-level data.
The source decision does not change the operating-cost range, its source, or the exclusion of the incomplete appendix amount.
A simpler model interface remains compatible with, and does not modify, the existing requirements to annotate assumptions and preserve their source basis.
The source concerns model understandability and organization, not the correctness of formulas, worksheet links, or calculated outputs.
Simplifying the interface does not remove or alter either funding scenario or the required finding about user-fee insufficiency.
The interface simplification decision does not change source-data verification, primary reference sources, or the demand analysis's directional role.
The source does not necessarily change the integrated three-statement structure or the financial-engine basis; interface organization can be simplified while retaining both.
Model-interface simplification has no effect on the CAD currency or 2026 price-base-year requirements.
The source does not alter the required revenue streams, pricing-assumption basis, or revenue-assumption documentation.
Simplifying the model interface does not change the DSCR and equity-IRR sizing criteria or their thresholds.
